first_step_test: The first crop is only a light, wide coat-body envelope: two shoulder slopes, reserved underarm breaks, flared sides, and a curved hem. Those keeper contours establish width and length before any small hood or hardware detail.

source.notes: Owner-directed October 1 process correction: approved six-panel square raster sheet begins with a broad body envelope, adds sleeves, then fits the hood and peg above stable shoulders. Steps 1 through 3 were individually repaired against the established Step 4 geometry. Prior hood-first and shifted candidate sheets remain private under rejected-progressions.

frames.visible_job: Draw the broad body silhouette at final size, leaving openings for sleeves and hood.
frames.instruction: With light HB pressure, place two short shoulder slopes on either side of a wide empty neckline. Leave a small break below each shoulder for the sleeves, then draw the two sides flaring gently to a shallow curved hem. Keep the body interior blank.

frames.visible_job: Add one sleeve and cuff at each reserved shoulder gap.
frames.instruction: From the left shoulder gap, pull a loose sleeve down and left to a short cuff, then return its inner edge to the existing left underarm. Mirror that move on the right without moving either side seam or the hem.

frames.visible_job: Add an open hood, one faint center seam, and one small peg above the coat.
frames.instruction: Above the empty neckline, draw a softly pointed outer hood that meets the two inner shoulder starts. Add a smaller open U-shaped rim and one faint center seam inside the hood. Center a small round wall plate and short downward peg above the hood tip; keep the hood interior mostly white.

frames.visible_job: Place a narrow center placket, four button circles, and one pocket flap per side.
frames.instruction: From below the hood opening, draw two close placket lines down to the hem. Space four small button circles inside it. Add one slanted pocket flap on each lower side, keeping both outside the placket and clear of the sleeves.

frames.visible_job: Draw two short hood cords, one inner hood fold, a few fabric creases, and faint wall shadow.
frames.instruction: Drop one short cord from each side of the hood rim, add a short inner-hood fold, then place a few brief creases below the shoulders and pockets. Shade lightly beneath and to the right of the coat; keep all keeper contours fixed.

final_step.visible_job: Deepen established pencil lines and add restrained mustard pencil to the complete coat.
final_step.instruction: Deepen selected existing hood, cuff, placket, and pocket edges. Layer soft mustard-yellow pencil over the hood, body, and sleeves, leaving paper highlights on the folds; preserve the peg, four buttons, two pockets, cords, and wall shadow exactly where drawn.
adds: graphite and mustard color on established contours

visual_review.first_step_observation: The saved first crop contains only two short shoulder slopes, two reserved breaks, flared body sides, and one shallow hem at the coat final size. It is a copyable simple envelope before sleeves, hood, peg, hardware, pockets, folds, or color.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: The five saved transitions add sleeves, hood and peg, front fastening and pockets, fabric details and shadow, then mustard coloring. Each previous keeper landmark stays in its established location; the finish colors contours already present. No temporary guides are used or removed.

transitions.observed_addition: The left and right drooping sleeves attach at the reserved outer shoulder corners, end in separate cuffs, and reconnect at the existing underarm bends. The two shoulder slopes, torso side seams, and curved hem remain in place.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved Step 2 shows the exact two sleeves and cuffs the instruction asks for; the body interior remains blank and the open hood space stays untouched.

transitions.observed_addition: A pointed open hood spans the empty neckline, meeting the same inner shoulder starts. A round wall plate and short vertical peg sit above its tip, and one faint seam drops inside the hood. Both sleeves, cuffs, side seams, and hem retain their positions.
transitions.instruction_match: The Step 3 instruction names the hood rim, faint center seam, and centered peg visible in the crop. Its inner hood opening remains mostly white for later detail.

transitions.observed_addition: Two close vertical placket edges descend from the hood opening to the same hem. Four separate circular buttons sit inside the placket, with one slanted pocket flap on each lower side. The peg, hood, shoulder joins, cuffs, and body silhouette stay anchored.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved Step 4 adds exactly the front fastening and two pocket flaps named by the instruction. No cord, shading, or color arrives early.

transitions.observed_addition: Two short cords descend beside the placket; a curved inner hood fold appears inside the opening. Sparse creases and light pencil texture sit on the existing sleeves and body, while a soft shadow appears to the coat lower right and under the hem. All four buttons and both pocket flaps remain in place.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved Step 5 contains the two cords, inner hood fold, fabric creases, and faint shadow requested in the instruction, without altering the structural outline.

transitions.observed_addition: Mustard pencil fills the already outlined hood, sleeves, and body, with darker graphite on their existing edges and shading inside the existing hood and wall shadow. The four buttons, two pockets, two cords, cuffs, peg, and hem remain readable and stationary.
transitions.instruction_match: The finish performs the instructed color and line-strengthening pass on established contours; no new structural feature or previously missing drawing problem appears.
